package golden.core;

// One import, deliberately unresolvable: the catalog fixtures declare no `provides`
// prefixes, so this specifier lands in arch-check's unresolvedImports count. That count
// is the assertion -- kill the .java/.kt/.kts/.scala extractor and it drops by one.
import golden.shared.FormatId;

public final class Probe {
  public static String probe() {
    return FormatId.of("probe");
  }
}
